name: Mrs. Knott's Famous Double-Crust Boysenberry Pie (Insoluble Berry Seed Warning!)
brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's & Farm Bakery (Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Reference warning: whole boysenberries (a cross between blackberry, raspberry, dewberry, and loganberry) are packed with hundreds of hard, woody, insoluble drupelet seeds that do not break down in the GI tract and can irritate Crohn's flares.
prepOrOrderInstructions: To enjoy Knott's famous boysenberry flavor safely without the seeds, skip whole-berry Boysenberry Pie and instead put **seedless strained Boysenberry Jelly** on a warm buttermilk biscuit or try a small taste of smooth Boysenberry Sherbet/Soft-Serve.
watchOuts: High concentration of hard insoluble boysenberry/blackberry seeds—avoid whole-berry pie filling during flares
